Availability failure before claiming returns WAIT_NO_LAUNCH without a background waiter. Exclusive fresh fixed output and immutable launch sentinel consume the attempt. One detached supervisor Popen and one child-launch callsite exist. The child requires a verified handle, repeat availability checks and fresh qualifier output. Poll never launches; missing/changed observations explicitly authorize neither retry nor relaunch. A post-claim failure leaves the fixed output claimed.

Identity failure records the observation and authorizes no signal. The helper registers its own fork result before later observation, is the sole wait4 reaper, and signals/cleans only recorded owned children. Its unrelated main/ordinary/native-training paths are not called.

PASS requires child exit0/final wait4, no external timeout, complete wait4 wall/RSS and finite original child elapsed/RSS/CUDA observations within the unchanged caps, exact immutable V3 PASS/worker pin, 284 callbacks, zero fits/updates, held access closed and empty error ledgers. Cleanup errors or an unreaped child force failure; receipt-read/final-publication failures cannot make the function return a successful code.
